title: Privacy Policy for PureRemote
intro: This Privacy Policy describes how PureRemote ("we," "us," "our," or the "App") handles information when you use our Android application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and being transparent about our data practices.

blocks.html: PureRemote is a remote control for Android TV and Google TV devices. It works directly between your phone and your TV over your local network. We run no servers for the App, and we do not collect, transmit, sell, or share your personal information.
PureRemote does not collect, access, or transmit:

items: Personal identifiers (name, email, phone number, address)
Account or sign-in information (the App has no accounts)
Location data
Contacts, photos, files, microphone, or camera data
Device identifiers or advertising IDs
Usage analytics, crash reports, or diagnostics
Any other personally identifiable information

blocks.html: We have no servers, databases, or third-party analytics or advertising services that receive your data.

sections.title: Information Stored Locally on Your Device

blocks.html: To work, the App keeps a small amount of data in its private storage on your phone:

items: A list of the TVs you have paired: the name and local network address (IP address) of each TV
A security certificate and private key generated on your phone, which the TV uses to recognize your phone after pairing

blocks.html: Important: This data never leaves your device through the App. You maintain full control over it.

The App searches your Wi-Fi network for compatible TVs and connects to the TV you choose. This traffic stays on your local network and is encrypted with TLS. The App does not send TV commands or pairing data to the internet.

items: Network access (INTERNET): to open connections to your TV on your local network. The App has no other internet features.
Network and Wi-Fi state (ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE) and multicast (CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE): to discover TVs on your Wi-Fi.
Vibration (VIBRATE): for button-press feedback.
Google Play Billing (BILLING): only for the optional tips. Payment is handled entirely by Google Play.

blocks.html: Since all data is stored locally on your device:

items: Retention: Your paired-TV list and pairing key stay on your device until you remove them or uninstall the App.

Deletion: Tap the bin icon on a TV's card to forget it. Uninstalling the App or clearing its storage in Android settings deletes everything the App stores, including the pairing key. To also remove your phone from a TV, remove it in the TV's own settings.

blocks.html: PureRemote is not directed at children under 13 years of age (or the applicable age in your jurisdiction), and we do not knowingly collect information from anyone, including children. Since the App does not collect any personal information, no special provisions for children's data are required.

sections.title: Information for Users in the European Economic Area (EEA), United Kingdom, and Switzerland — GDPR Compliance

blocks.html: If you are located in the European Economic Area, United Kingdom, or Switzerland, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and equivalent local laws apply to you.

Since PureRemote does not collect or process your personal data on external servers, there is no data controller relationship established between us and you for the data stored on your device. You act as the sole controller of that data.
We do not process your personal data. The small amount of data the App stores is used only on your device, under your control, to provide the remote-control function you asked for.
Although we do not hold any of your personal data, we acknowledge your rights under GDPR, including:

items: Right of Access: Your paired-TV list is visible to you in the App at any time.
Right to Rectification: You may forget and re-pair a TV to correct its entry.
Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): You may forget a TV, clear the App's storage, or uninstall the App to remove all data.
Right to Data Portability: The App holds no personal content to port.
Right to Restrict Processing and Right to Object: You control all processing on your device. No automated decision-making or profiling occurs.

blocks.html: We do not transfer your data internationally or to any external parties, as no data leaves your device through the App.

sections.title: Information for California Residents — CCPA and CPRA Compliance

blocks.html: If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), provides you with specific rights regarding your personal information.
PureRemote does not collect, sell, or share any personal information as defined by the CCPA/CPRA. Specifically:
As a California resident, you have the following rights:

items: Right to Know: Since we collect no personal information, there is nothing to disclose.
Right to Delete: All App data is stored locally and can be deleted by you at any time.
Right to Correct: You may forget and re-pair a TV to correct its entry.
Right to Opt-Out of Sale/Sharing: We do not sell or share your personal information.
Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information: We do not collect sensitive personal information.
Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights.

blocks.text: 9.3 Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

blocks.html: PureRemote does not sell or share your personal information as defined under CCPA/CPRA, and has not done so in the preceding 12 months.

sections.title: California Online Privacy Protection Act (CalOPPA) Compliance

blocks.html: In accordance with CalOPPA, we disclose the following:
We do not collect personally identifiable information from users of this App.
We do not allow third parties to collect personally identifiable information about your online activities over time or across different websites or applications.
The App does not track users across third-party websites or apps. It does not respond to Do Not Track (DNT) signals because no tracking occurs.

The App contains no ads, analytics, or third-party SDKs that collect data. It uses Google's Play Billing library for the optional tips. If you leave a tip, Google Play handles the payment: the App does not see or store your payment details or Google account details, and it only receives confirmation that the purchase went through, which it does not keep. Links to rate the App or to the developer's other app open Google Play. Google collects its own information about installs, purchases, and reviews under Google's policies.

Your pairing key is stored in the App's private storage and is protected by Android's app sandbox. Android's cloud backup is turned off for this App, so this data is not copied to Google backups. We encourage you to:

items: Keep your phone secure with a screen lock. Anyone with access to your unlocked phone can control the TVs you have paired.
Keep your phone's operating system updated.

blocks.html: The App does not know who leaves a tip. If you would like to be credited, you can email your name (and an optional message or link) to shinakumalabs@zohomail.in. That is entirely your choice. Your details are used only to list you on the developer's supporters page, are published only with your consent, and you can ask for them to be removed or deleted at any time.

If this policy changes, the "Last Updated" date at the top will change. Material changes will be described in the App's release notes. Your continued use of the App after any modifications indicates your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.
If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:
Email: shinakumalabs@zohomail.in
By downloading, installing, and using PureRemote, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to this Privacy Policy.
This Privacy Policy is effective as of the "Last Updated" date listed above.
